reason: The system demonstrated a fundamental failure to progress beyond its initial recommendation despite explicit user feedback indicating prior familiarity with the suggested title. After clearly stating I had already seen Arrival, the assistant repeated the identical recommendation three consecutive times without acknowledging the rejection or pivoting to alternatives. This represents a critical breakdown in conversational coherence. The initial clarification questions were reasonably structured, but the system's inability to incorporate feedback or differentiate among its visible options renders the interaction essentially non-functional. I came seeking resolution to a weeks-long search; instead, I encountered a system stuck in a loop.
clarifyingNotes: The first two clarification questions—regarding tone and content constraints—were appropriately targeted and helped establish my preferences around contemplative cinema, accessibility needs, and content boundaries. However, these questions proved meaningless when the system failed to use the gathered information to either adapt its recommendations or explain why alternatives from its own list might or might not suit my stated criteria. The clarification process was sound in isolation but disconnected from any meaningful recommendation logic.
